extracted.name: Super Easy, Super Tasty Tuna Casserole
extracted.description: Had a ton of leftover spaghetti noodles, so decided to use them creatively.
instruction_lines: Mix all ingredients together in a big bowl and spread in a 9x13 glass baking pan. Top with panko. Cover with aluminum foil.
Bake at 350 for 25 minutes, or until center is warm. Remove aluminum foil and bake for 5 more minutes to crisp the panko breadcrumbs.
